Definition: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
BiblicalUsage: 1) way, road, distance, journey, manner; 1a) road, way, path; 1b) journey; 1c) direction; 1d) manner, habit, way; 1e) of course of life (fig.); 1f) of moral character (fig.)
